title: GraphiQL: Explore and Test GraphQL Queries | Orchard Core
description:
Testing a GraphQL query usually means guessing the names of fields and sending requests from a separate tool.

The GraphQL module includes GraphiQL, a page of the admin where you build queries by clicking fields, read the schema of your content types, run a query as the signed-in user, and read the response. It sends the same request that your own applications send to the GraphQL endpoint.

In this video:
• What GraphiQL is, and the endpoint it calls
• Opening GraphiQL and the layout of the screen
• Building and running a query in the Explorer
• Browsing the schema with Docs
• Variables, and the address that keeps your query
• Errors in the editor and in the response
• The same request from your own code
